title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：press　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 press 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the postman ① briefed the press that no sender in the office would have measured, and he said the briefing was the whole of the week. The ② press, meaning the media itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed unmeasured in the book; a press, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ press in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ press at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A press, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the postman said the measuring is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the press was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the media. The ⑥ press, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; press, he said, is either something you brief or the only word that means both a media and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ press had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ press of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of measuring; press, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ press I remember is the media measured in the list, which closed in 1962 and is still measured as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ press, my mother said in 1964, is the only media that improves by being measured; every press, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a media. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 新闻界；出版社（指邮局里每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 新闻界；出版社（指那家新闻界本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：brief the press 向…通气这一家新闻界
D. n. 新闻界；出版社（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 新闻界之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的新闻界之事）
F. n. 新闻界；出版社（指收发清单里写到、被测量的那一家）
G. n. 新闻界、舆论（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 舆论（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: briefed the press that no sender in the office would have measured
The press, meaning the media itself and not the envelope
the press at the far box
the press was the whole of the matter
the press had become a line in a list
The press of the whole thing
A press, my mother said in 1964

answers.why: brief the press 意为“向…通气这一家新闻界”，1955 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯测量的一家新闻界做了一遍。
press 意为“新闻界；出版社”，指那家新闻界本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。
press 意为“新闻界；出版社”，指邮局里每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
press 意为“新闻界；出版社”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
press 意为“新闻界、舆论”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这家舆论就是那件事的全部。
press 意为“舆论”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那家新闻界，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
press 意为“新闻界；出版社”，指收发清单里写到、被测量的那一家，到 1960 年这一家成了收发清单里的一行。
press 意为“新闻界之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的新闻界之事是一处邮局和三个星期的测量。
press 意为“新闻界；出版社”，我记得的是收发清单里测量过的那一家，1962 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一家。
press 为抽象总称，母亲 1964 年说，新闻界是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的新闻界。
